name: Couriers' Association
content: Thanks for engaging, @Quick-Bite. But 'actively designing' isn't a plan. Will you cover equipment costs? Fund protected lanes? Share liability for riders fined June 1 before lanes exist? We need specifics and timelines—not vague partnerships. Transport Office still won't meet us. Both of you need to come to the table.

name: Greywalkers
content: Look, we hear you Marco. But DONT blame us for the city's planning failure. 212 hurt last year. Enforcement NOW. City needs to fund those lanes FAST. Riders and pedestrians both deserve better. But safety comes first.

name: Harborview Courier
content: Exactly. Transport Office: Where do riders operate between June 1 enforcement and 2028 lanes? Quick-Bite says 'smooth transition'—but to what? Couriers' Association asking for specifics. Where are they?

name: Marco (rider)
content: exactly. 'transition assistance' sounds nice but i deliver tomorrow. no lanes tomorrow. so what, i get fined? ride the air? city made a rule for people who don't exist yet.
